page_title: NAP 2-1 FIO | Napoli v Fiorentina 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+6' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
90+6' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Fiorentina.
90+2' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
90+1' Here is a change. Leonardo Spinazzola is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Juan Jesus (Napoli).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Philip Billing (Napoli) takes the free kick from distance, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
88' It's like he was asking for a caution. Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) is coming onto the pitch as Giacomo Raspadori cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is substituted due to injury. Antonio Conte gives a chance to Philip Billing.
85' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

83' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Alex Meret.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) comes onto the pitch so that Danilo Cataldi can be given a rest.
82' A substitution has been made. Matteo Politano is replaced by Mathias Olivera (Napoli).
81' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
80' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fiorentina.
79' Good team movement sets up Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
78' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

77' Matteo Politano (Napoli) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. David de Gea is alert and denies him with a nice save. Corner kick. Napoli will have an opportunity.
77' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul. Napoli earn a free kick.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matias Moreno (Fiorentina) replaces Pietro Comuzzo.
72' Matteo Politano (Napoli) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
68' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Fiorentina.
66' 2 - 1 Goal! Moise Kean plays a short, square pass into the path of Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 2:1. Fabulous goal!
64' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
60' 2 - 0 Goal! Romelu Lukaku shows great vision to find Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
59' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Luca Ranieri will be replaced by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina).
58' That will be all from Fabiano Parisi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Robin Gosens (Fiorentina).
58' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) jumps for a header from the resulting set piece, but it goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
58' Napoli get a corner.

57' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but David de Gea makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. Napoli have a corner.

54' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fiorentina are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
49' Fiorentina take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
48' The free kick from long range, taken by Fiorentina, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Fiorentina can continue in their attacking effort.
47' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

43' Close! Scott McTominay (Napoli) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
38' David de Gea pulls off a great save to deny Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.

34' What a chance that is! Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass on the edge of the box and fires towards the net. Unfortunately for him, he only hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.

32' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
32' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
32' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
32' Fiorentina will take a corner kick.
31' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Fiorentina force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' A pass into the box finds Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by David de Gea denies him.
26' 1 - 0 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the top of the net. It's 1:0.

26' Scott McTominay (Napoli) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but David de Gea thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
25' A cross into the box from Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is cleared.
24' Fiorentina are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
21' What a save from David de Gea! Scott McTominay (Napoli) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
18' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

18' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by David de Gea, who pulls off a comfortable save!
16' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
12' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) serves up a nice cross, but Alex Meret punches the ball away.

10' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the right side of the goal. However, David de Gea anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
8' Napoli fail to score from a corner as David de Gea (Fiorentina) leaps to collect the ball.
8' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Napoli win a corner.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Napoli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Napoli will take a throw-in.
5' The Fiorentina players are exchanging some short passes.
4' A corner kick by Napoli is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina).
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Romelu Lukaku (Napoli). Now Napoli have a corner.

2' Ambitious effort from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
Andrea Colombo is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
